name: Guo Jia
lore: Cao Cao's strategist in many battles. Against Yuan Shao he foresaw every move. A master schemer who saw the truth of things, he made Cao Cao say: 'Only Guo Jia understands my intent.'
battleCry:
Whatever schemes you devise,
it all falls within my grasp.

formation.name: Assault
formation.description: Raises POW and Horse Charge damage.

dialogue.greeting1:
So you're my lord for life?
I'm Guo Jia. Pleased to meet you.
dialogue.greeting2:
My Abilities at their finest...
I expect you can master them.
dialogue.goBattleBefore:
Let me train the troops so we can
carry out my Abilities swiftly.
dialogue.goBattle:
No loose ends? Good.
Let's move out.
dialogue.trainingExpect: The troops seem spirited today.
dialogue.tokkun: Special training, eh? I saw it coming.
dialogue.mockBattle: A drill. Just as I predicted.
dialogue.hunting: We can't miss this opportunity.
dialogue.endTraining: Not bad. Not bad at all.

name: Sima Yi
lore: Wei's great strategist. Feigning illness, he refused office until Cao Cao summoned him. Trusted by Cao Pi and Cao Rui, he thwarted Zhuge Liang's northern campaigns and crushed Gongsun Yuan's revolt.
battleCry:
Prepare until victory is certain, then fight.
Gambling is for the third-rate.

dialogue.greeting1: Hmph. A pleasure to make your acquaintance.
dialogue.greeting2:
I shall serve as your Sage, Sir.
The name is Sima Yi Zhongda.
dialogue.greeting3:
With my Abilities, I shall bring
certain ruin upon the enemy army.
dialogue.goBattleBefore:
Allow me to train the troops
so my Abilities cannot fail.
dialogue.goBattle: With me here, victory is assured.
dialogue.trainingExpect:
Hmph. Today I shall drill
the troops thoroughly.
dialogue.tokkun: I would leave this to a steady Lord.
dialogue.mockBattle: I would leave this to a steady Lord.
dialogue.hunting: A bold move now and then is no bad thing.

name: Xun Yu
lore: Of a noble clan, he was hailed from youth as having 'the talent to aid a king.' As Cao Cao's advisor he upheld him in all military and state affairs, laying the groundwork for his conquest of the realm.
battleCry:
Please, use my wisdom
to bring this nation back to life.

tactics.name: Regroup
tactics.description: Sends allies to Castle; speeds revival.

dialogue.greeting1:
A pleasure to meet you, Sir.
My name is Xun Yu.
dialogue.greeting2:
My Abilities shall aid you, Sir,
on your road to rule the realm.
dialogue.goBattleBefore:
To hone my Abilities, I would like
to train the troops, if I may.
dialogue.training: Field training, is it? Very well.
dialogue.trainingExpect:
I sense today's training
will go well.
dialogue.tokkun: Special training? I'll go pick a Lord.
dialogue.mockBattle: A drill? I'll go pick a Lord.
dialogue.hunting: Let us take it on without fear of failure.

name: Xun You
lore: Xun Yu's nephew, who served Cao Cao on his uncle's recommendation. A meticulous planner, he never revealed his schemes. Outwardly dull, he hid courage within and served Cao Cao as strategist to the end.
battleCry:
Caution alone won't
bring your plans to life.

dialogue.greeting1:
Hey, great to meet you!
I'm Xun You. Let's work together.
dialogue.greeting2:
My Abilities are easy to use
and handy in all sorts of situations.
dialogue.greeting3:
They'll definitely come in handy
in your battles!
dialogue.goBattleBefore:
I'll run some training,
so my powers can really shine.
dialogue.trainingExpect:
Nice weather today!
Feels like it'll go well.
dialogue.tokkun: Special training, huh? Who should I ask...
dialogue.mockBattle: A drill, huh? Who should I ask...
dialogue.hunting: Nice! I think that's the right call.
dialogue.endTraining: Right, that should about do it.

name: Chen Qun
lore: A noted scholar who served Cao Cao, Cao Pi and Cao Rui. His Nine-Rank System of appointment stabilized Wei. Aiding Emperor Cao Rui in politics and the war on Shu, he rose to Minister of Works.
battleCry: Let me shape the battle I envision.

dialogue.greeting1:
It is an honor to meet you, Sir.
My name is Chen Qun.
dialogue.greeting2:
The Abilities I wield are classics,
tried and true.
dialogue.greeting3:
I promise to bring certain
victory to your battles, Sir.
dialogue.goBattleBefore:
Allow me to hold training
to hone my Abilities.
dialogue.goBattle:
Time to show the fruits
of our daily work.
dialogue.trainingExpect: I sense today's training will go well.
dialogue.tokkun: Let us entrust this to a worthy Lord.
dialogue.mockBattle: Let us entrust this to a worthy Lord.
dialogue.hunting: A sound decision.
dialogue.success: This training was a great success!
dialogue.failed: Did we pick the wrong Lord...?

name: Zhuge Liang
lore: Genius strategist who joined Liu Bei after the Three Visits. Crucial at Red Cliffs and Shu's conquest. As Chancellor, he managed all state affairs and led multiple northern campaigns against Wei.
battleCry:
Three realms made one...
My plan does not end with the realm in three.

tactics.name: Seven Stars
tactics.description: Restores allies' HP past the maximum.

dialogue.greeting1:
Pleased to meet you.
I am Kongming.
dialogue.greeting2:
From this day, I shall look to you as my lord
and give my all for the realm.
dialogue.goBattleBefore:
To lead my Abilities to new heights,
allow me to hold training.
dialogue.goBattle:
Time to march.
Do not let your guard down...
dialogue.trainingExpect:
The troops are in fine form today.
Expect results.
dialogue.tokkun: Let us choose a dependable Lord.
dialogue.mockBattle: Leave the choice of Lord to me.
dialogue.hunting: That would be the wisest course.
dialogue.success: The training was without a flaw.
dialogue.failed: Did I choose the wrong Lord...?

name: Ma Su
lore: Joined Liu Bei with his brother Ma Liang and studied politics and war as Zhuge Liang's prized pupil. In the Nanman campaign he urged sparing Meng Huo, winning the tribes over and securing Shu's rear.
battleCry:
My strategy is flawless!
Execute it at once!

tactics.name: Regroup
tactics.description: Sends allies to Castle; speeds revival.

dialogue.greeting1:
Sir, it is an honor to meet you!
I am Ma Su.
dialogue.greeting2:
With my flawless Abilities, I shall
deliver you a crushing victory!
dialogue.goBattleBefore:
To make my plans more perfect still,
I shall train these soldiers!
dialogue.trainingExpect:
My brilliance is flowing
more than ever today!
dialogue.tokkun:
Special training!
I shall pick a fine Lord!
dialogue.mockBattle:
A drill!
I shall pick a fine Lord!
dialogue.hunting: Success is assured, you'll see!
dialogue.success: My training today was the finest!

name: Mi Zhu
lore: A wealthy merchant who became Liu Bei's patron during his wandering years, supporting him until Shu's conquest. So valued were his contributions that Liu Bei ranked him above even Zhuge Liang.
battleCry:
W-will this be all right?
I am not terribly confident...

dialogue.greeting1:
P-pleased to meet you.
My name is Mi Zhu.
dialogue.greeting2:
Humble as my strength is, I hope
to help you take the realm, Sir.
dialogue.greeting3:
My Abilities are easy to use,
so please make full use of them.
dialogue.goBattleBefore:
W-well then, to hone my Abilities,
I would like to hold some training...
dialogue.trainingExpect: I have a good feeling about today.
dialogue.tokkun: Th-then I shall go pick a Lord!
dialogue.mockBattle: Th-then I shall go pick a Lord!
dialogue.hunting:
Th-that's a rare one!
Let's be sure we succeed!

name: Fa Zheng
lore: Once served Liu Zhang but, feeling undervalued, he encouraged Liu Bei to seize Shu. After joining Liu Bei, he urged the invasion of Hanzhong and was key to its capture as chief strategist.
battleCry:
At last, my talents
see the light of day...!

formation.name: Spear Flash
formation.description: Raises POW and Spear Units' reach.

dialogue.greeting1:
I have long awaited the day we'd meet.
How do you do? I am Fa Zheng.
dialogue.greeting2:
With my Abilities, I shall surely
lead you to rule the realm, Sir.
dialogue.goBattleBefore:
Allow me to hold training so
I can use my Abilities swiftly.
dialogue.goBattle:
I'll be the one to lead you
to rule the realm!
dialogue.training: Field training to toughen them up?
dialogue.trainingExpect: Today's training should go well.
dialogue.tokkun: Special training to toughen them up?
dialogue.mockBattle:
I'll pick two Lords
for a drill.
dialogue.hunting:
Success here will lead
to further growth.
dialogue.endTraining: Not a bad session at all.
dialogue.failed: I never expected it to fail...

name: Pang Tong
lore: Liu Bei's strategist called the Fledgling Phoenix, rivaling Zhuge Liang in wisdom. His Chained Ships scheme helped win Red Cliffs. After joining Liu Bei, he urged the conquest of Shu.
battleCry: Now they're pinned down, easy as that!

dialogue.greeting1:
So you're my lord, huh?
Name's Pang Tong.
dialogue.greeting2:
Make use of my outlandish schemes,
and victory will surely be yours.
dialogue.goBattleBefore:
Let me train the troops
so we can execute my plans better.
dialogue.trainingExpect: Got a good feeling about today.
dialogue.tokkun: Time to test my eye for talent.
dialogue.mockBattle: Let's pick someone who's a good match.
dialogue.hunting:
It's risky, but this chance
is too good to miss.

name: Zhou Yu
lore: Sworn brother and strategist to Sun Ce, he drove his swift advance. Under Sun Quan he routed Cao Cao's army with fire at Red Cliffs. He then planned to annex Shu and Hanzhong, but died at just 36.
battleCry:
Zhou Yu fights
for nothing less than the realm!

dialogue.greeting1:
It is an honor to meet you, Sir.
I am Zhou Yu.
dialogue.greeting2:
With my Abilities, I shall reduce
the enemy army to ashes!
dialogue.goBattleBefore:
Let me train the troops
to execute my strategies flawlessly.
dialogue.goBattle:
Time to march.
Let's show them our strength!
dialogue.training: Let field training win us the day.
dialogue.trainingExpect:
An auspicious day.
We should do better than usual.
dialogue.tokkun: This will be crucial training.
dialogue.mockBattle:
A drill.
I'd like this to succeed.
dialogue.hunting:
A chance like this
must not be wasted.
dialogue.success: This training was a great success!

name: Zhang Zhao
lore: A sage who joined Sun Ce at his call, then served Sun Quan. He long upheld the young lord but rebuked him so often that, though many thought him the right man, he was never made Chancellor.
battleCry:
Sir, please
heed my counsel now!

tactics.name: Regroup
tactics.description: Sends allies to Castle; speeds revival.

dialogue.greeting1:
Sir! A pleasure to meet you!
I am Zhang Zhao!
dialogue.greeting2:
My Abilities shall aid you
in your battles, Sir!
dialogue.goBattleBefore:
Sir! Let me train the troops so they
carry out my plans without error!
dialogue.training: Field training, eh? A fine choice.
dialogue.trainingExpect:
I sense today's training
will go splendidly!
dialogue.tokkun: Special training is not bad either, eh?
dialogue.mockBattle: Now, which Lord shall I choose...
dialogue.hunting: Hm, this is our only option.
dialogue.failed: Hmm... The wrong Lord, was it?

name: Lu Xun
lore: Wu's great strategist after Zhou Yu and Lu Meng. With Lu Meng he beat Guan Yu in Jing Province; at Yiling he crushed Shu's vast army with fire. He repelled every Wei attack and rose to Chancellor.
battleCry: I, Lu Xun, shall guard the lands of Wu.

dialogue.greeting1:
It is an honor to meet you, Sir.
I am Lu Xun.
dialogue.greeting2:
My Abilities shall surely save you
whenever you are in a tight spot.
dialogue.goBattleBefore:
Let me train the troops
to ensure our strategies succeed.
dialogue.training: Field training isn't a bad choice.
dialogue.trainingExpect:
I sense today's training
will go well.
dialogue.tokkun: Let's hope for good results.
dialogue.mockBattle: I would very much like this to succeed.
dialogue.hunting:
Chances like this are rare.
Let's make it count.

name: Lu Meng
lore: Served Sun Quan from youth. Once a mere warrior, he took up study at Sun Quan's urging and became a general of wit and valor. After Lu Su died he led Wu's army, defeated Guan Yu and won Jing Province.
battleCry: Look upon my strategy with new eyes!

formation.name: Far Shot
formation.description: Raises POW and Bow Units' range.

dialogue.greeting1:
Sir, it is an honor to meet you.
I am Lu Meng.
dialogue.greeting2:
I have hastened here to help you
seize the realm, Sir.
dialogue.greeting3:
My strategies draw out the full might of Wu.
Please put them to good use.
dialogue.goBattleBefore:
To hone my Abilities, I would like
to put the troops through training.
dialogue.training: Field training to toughen them up?
dialogue.trainingExpect:
The troops are fired up today.
Expect fine results.
dialogue.tokkun: Toughen them up with special training?
dialogue.mockBattle:
I'll pick two Lords
for a drill.
dialogue.hunting:
Success here will lead
to further growth.

name: Lu Su
lore: Zhou Yu recommended him to Sun Quan. He allied with the wandering Liu Bei, and when Cao Cao's host bore down on Wu, he pressed for battle. After Zhou Yu died he led Wu's forces and kept the alliance.
battleCry:
If we don't act now,
Cao Cao will swallow Wu whole!

dialogue.greeting1:
A pleasure to meet you!
I am Lu Su. Do remember me!
dialogue.greeting2:
My Abilities are easy to use
in both attack and defense.
dialogue.greeting3:
I believe you can use them
just as you please, Sir!
dialogue.goBattleBefore:
To hone my Abilities,
allow me to hold some training!
dialogue.training: Then let us begin field training!
dialogue.trainingExpect: I sense today's training will go well!
dialogue.tokkun:
I'll go pick a Lord
for special training!
dialogue.mockBattle: Then let us start the drill!
dialogue.hunting: Success here would be huge!

name: Jia Xu
lore: Dong Zhuo's strategist, later serving several lords in turn. As Zhang Xiu's advisor he fought Cao Cao. His counsel never failed: when Zhang Xiu heeded him he won; when he did not, he lost.
battleCry: My wisdom yields endless stratagems.

dialogue.greeting1:
I am Jia Xu.
Sir, I trust you will remember me.
dialogue.greeting2:
With my supreme strategies,
I shall surely bring you victory.
dialogue.goBattleBefore:
Allow me to train the troops
to perfect my strategies...
dialogue.goBattle: Onward to battle, armed with my schemes.
dialogue.trainingExpect:
Today especially, I feel
training will go well.
dialogue.tokkun:
I see...
Now, which Lord to choose...
dialogue.mockBattle: A drill. Not bad.
dialogue.hunting: A wise choice, I must say.
dialogue.failed: How unlike me. I misjudged it.

name: Zhang Jiao
lore: Founder of the Taiping faith, he led millions of followers, the Yellow Turbans, against the Han. The revolt was crushed, but its remnants rose across the land for decades, leading to the dynasty's fall.
battleCry:
March on without fear of death!
Heaven itself wills a Yellow Turban age!

tactics.name: Taiping Art
tactics.description: Shortens revival time and restores HP.

dialogue.greeting1:
A pleasure to meet you!
I am Zhang Jiao!
dialogue.greeting2:
That we meet like this
is the guidance of Heaven!
dialogue.greeting3:
With my power, we shall surely
build a Yellow Turban age!
dialogue.goBattleBefore:
Let me hold training, that my
Abilities may rise to Heaven!
dialogue.trainingExpect:
Heaven's voice tells me
today will go well!
dialogue.tokkun: Heaven's voice calls for special training!
dialogue.mockBattle: Heaven's voice calls for a drill!
dialogue.hunting: Heed the voice of Heaven and succeed!
dialogue.endTraining: The training has paid off, I say!
dialogue.success: Heaven truly smiled on us today!

name: Chen Gong
lore: He served Cao Cao but rebelled while Cao Cao attacked Xu Province, took in Lu Bu and became his strategist. He fought Cao Cao to the end but lost, partly as Lu Bu ignored his advice, and was executed.
battleCry:
Chen Gong shall guide you
to victory...!!

dialogue.greeting1:
Sir! It is an honor to meet you!
I am Chen Gong!
dialogue.greeting2:
With my Abilities, I shall surely
lead you to rule the realm, Sir!
dialogue.goBattleBefore:
Sir, will you not let me hold training
to sharpen my strategies?!
dialogue.trainingExpect:
Spirits are high today!
Fine results, without fail!
dialogue.tokkun: Special training! Very well!
dialogue.mockBattle: This drill will succeed, you'll see!
dialogue.hunting: This will be fine training!

name: Mi Heng
lore: A civil official of keen insight and wit, so arrogant that his criticism knew no bounds and he was widely hated. He joined Cao Cao and Liu Biao, but each drove him out for his venomous tongue.
battleCry:
Hah! As if fools could
understand my genius!

dialogue.greeting1:
Heh. First time meetin', huh?
I'm Mi Heng!
dialogue.greeting2:
My schemes are a cut above
all the idiots out there!
dialogue.greeting3:
I figure you can handle 'em.
So I'm countin' on ya!
dialogue.goBattleBefore:
Ugh, what a pain, but I'll train
the troops to pull off my plans!
dialogue.goBattle: What a drag, but let's fight!
dialogue.training: I'm in command. No way it fails.
dialogue.trainingExpect: Feelin' good today!
dialogue.tokkun: Special training? Not my show, then.
dialogue.mockBattle: A drill, huh? Who'll I pick...
dialogue.hunting: Pull this off and it's big, ain't it?

name: Li Ru
lore: Dong Zhuo's aide in his reign of terror. When Emperor Xian was enthroned he poisoned the old emperor and his mother, Empress He. He killed Coalition leader Yuan Shao's kin and held Hulao Pass with Lu Bu.
battleCry:
Fools who defy us shall
pay for their sins in blood.

dialogue.greeting1:
Heh heh. A pleasure to meet you, Sir.
I am Li Ru.
dialogue.greeting2:
With my versatile Abilities,
I shall aid your path to supremacy.
dialogue.goBattleBefore:
Allow me to train the troops
to add power to my strategies.
dialogue.goBattle:
To battle!
The realm shall be ours...!
dialogue.trainingExpect:
Heh heh...
Heh heh heh heh heh...
dialogue.tokkun: Special training will do nicely.
dialogue.mockBattle: A drill is no bad choice.
dialogue.hunting:
Very well... We'll make them
regret ever being born.
dialogue.endTraining: Heh heh. The training paid off.
